summary: Async support does not work with NativeEnvironment when rendering a list.
issue_text: When enable_async=True is used with NativeEnvironment, calling render_async with a list raises TypeError: sequence item 0: expected str instance, list found. Synchronous render returns the list as expected. The reproducer calls env.from_string('{{ items }}').render_async(items=[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9]).
traceback_excerpt: jinja2/asyncsupport.py, in concat_async: return concat(rv); TypeError: sequence item 0: expected str instance, list found.
dependency_note: Requires Python 3.8 and MarkupSafe==1.1.1; older Jinja 2.11.x uses soft_unicode which was removed in MarkupSafe 2.1+ and Python 3.10+.
